nodes.name: util.rs
nodes.summary: Shared git subprocess execution utilities: retrying command runner with FD-safe spawning (closes inherited file descriptors to avoid WebView FD leaks), git executable resolution, proxy configuration, and git user identity/profile management.
nodes.languageNotes: Closes file descriptors 3-1024 via a Unix `pre_exec` hook before spawning git subprocesses to prevent 'Bad file descriptor' errors caused by the embedded WebView leaking FDs into child processes.

nodes.name: is_transient_error
nodes.summary: Classifies a git error message as transient (network blip, lock contention) versus a real failure, used to decide whether to retry.

nodes.name: user_friendly_error
nodes.summary: Translates a raw git error message plus the attempted operation into a user-facing error string.

nodes.name: operation_name_from_args
nodes.summary: Infers a human-readable operation name (e.g. 'commit', 'push') from a git command's argument list, for logging and error messages.

nodes.name: resolved_git_executable
nodes.summary: Returns the resolved path to the git executable to use for all subprocess invocations.

nodes.name: resolved_git_executable_details
nodes.summary: Returns the resolved git executable path along with diagnostic details about how it was found.

nodes.name: resolve_git_executable_from_candidates
nodes.summary: Picks the first working git executable from a list of candidate paths, preferring the system git.

nodes.name: git_command
nodes.summary: Builds a `std::process::Command` for git with FD-safe spawning configured.

nodes.name: tokio_git_command
nodes.summary: Builds a `tokio::process::Command` for git with FD-safe spawning and, on Windows, the `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` flag to suppress console flashing.

nodes.name: close_inherited_fds
nodes.summary: Configures a command to close inherited file descriptors 3-1024 before exec on Unix (a cfg-gated no-op on other platforms), preventing the embedded WebView's file descriptors from leaking into git subprocesses and causing 'Bad file descriptor' errors.

nodes.name: spawn_git_command_internal
nodes.summary: Internal helper that spawns a configured git command and captures its output asynchronously.

nodes.name: run_git_with_retry
nodes.summary: Runs a git command with retry-on-transient-error, up to a configurable retry count.

nodes.name: run_git_with_retry_friendly
nodes.summary: Runs a git command with retries and converts any final failure into a user-friendly error message.

nodes.name: run_git
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper running a git command once with the default retry count.

nodes.name: run_git_status_with_retry
nodes.summary: Runs `git status` with retry handling, used by callers that need dirty-state checks.

nodes.name: read_git_config_key
nodes.summary: Reads a git config key scoped to a specific repository.

nodes.name: read_global_git_config_key
nodes.summary: Reads a git config key from the global (user-level) git configuration.

nodes.name: get_git_proxy_config
nodes.summary: Tauri command reading the configured HTTP/HTTPS proxy for a repository (or globally) from git config.

nodes.name: write_git_config_key
nodes.summary: Writes a git config key, scoped to either the repository or the global config.

nodes.name: unset_git_config_key
nodes.summary: Removes a git config key, scoped to either the repository or the global config.

nodes.name: set_git_proxy_config
nodes.summary: Tauri command that sets the HTTP/HTTPS proxy in git config, either repo-scoped or global.

nodes.name: unset_git_proxy_config
nodes.summary: Tauri command that removes the configured proxy from git config.

nodes.name: read_gh_cli_username
nodes.summary: Parses `~/.config/gh/hosts.yml` to read the GitHub CLI's authenticated username, used as a fallback identity source.

nodes.name: get_git_user_identity
nodes.summary: Tauri command returning the effective git user name/email for a repository, falling back through repo, global, and `gh` CLI config.

nodes.name: get_git_global_profile
nodes.summary: Tauri command returning the global git user name/email configuration.

nodes.name: set_git_global_profile
nodes.summary: Tauri command that sets the global git user name/email configuration.

nodes.name: ResolvedGitExecutable
nodes.summary: Holds the resolved git executable path and how it was located.

nodes.name: GitProxyInfo
nodes.summary: Holds the configured HTTP/HTTPS proxy values for a repository or global scope.

nodes.name: GitUserIdentity
nodes.summary: Holds the effective git user name/email resolved for a repository.

nodes.name: GitGlobalProfile
nodes.summary: Holds the global git user name/email configuration.

nodes.name: commands.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command surface exposing the repo file-watching subsystem to the frontend: start/stop watching, query cached status and health, and control adaptive polling behavior (window focus, Source Control visibility).

nodes.name: watch_repos
nodes.summary: Tauri command that starts watching a list of repositories, initializing the global `RepoWatchManager` on first use.

nodes.name: unwatch_repo
nodes.summary: Tauri command that stops watching a single repository.

nodes.name: unwatch_all_repos
nodes.summary: Tauri command that stops watching all currently watched repositories.

nodes.name: get_repo_status
nodes.summary: Tauri command returning the cached git status for a single repository.

nodes.name: force_refresh_repo
nodes.summary: Tauri command that forces an immediate git status refresh for a repository, bypassing the cache.

nodes.name: get_all_repo_statuses
nodes.summary: Tauri command returning cached git status for all watched repositories.

nodes.name: get_watcher_health
nodes.summary: Tauri command returning health diagnostics for all watched repositories.

nodes.name: get_watch_status
nodes.summary: Tauri command returning the overall watch subsystem status (mode, watched repo count).

nodes.name: set_window_focus
nodes.summary: Tauri command notifying the watcher of window focus changes, used to adjust polling frequency.

nodes.name: set_source_control_attention
nodes.summary: Tauri command notifying the watcher that the Source Control UI is visible, bumping polling to the fast interval.

nodes.name: set_active_git_polling_repo
nodes.summary: Tauri command setting which repository is allowed to use periodic working-directory polling.

nodes.name: RepoInfoDto
nodes.summary: Frontend-facing DTO describing a repository to watch (ID, path, name).

nodes.name: debounce.rs
nodes.summary: Adaptive debounce manager that coalesces rapid filesystem events, diffs consecutive git status snapshots to synthesize higher-level operation events (commit, checkout, merge, rebase, conflict), and throttles concurrent git subprocess execution.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `tauri::async_runtime::spawn` instead of `tokio::spawn` for scheduled flushes because callers may run on a plain `std::thread` without an active Tokio runtime; also uses an `AtomicU32` semaphore (`MAX_CONCURRENT_GIT_OPS=1`) to serialize git subprocess execution and avoid FD exhaustion.

nodes.name: truncate_preview
nodes.summary: Truncates a string to a maximum byte length at a UTF-8-safe boundary, used for preview text in emitted operation events.

nodes.name: status_snapshot_changed
nodes.summary: Compares two `GitStatus` snapshots for equality, short-circuiting further processing when nothing changed.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a `DebounceManager` with empty pending-event and last-flush-time maps.

nodes.name: detect_and_emit_operations
nodes.summary: Diffs an old and new `GitStatus` snapshot to infer and emit higher-level git operation events (commit, checkout, push, fetch/pull, merge start/complete, rebase start/complete, conflict detected/resolved).

nodes.name: trigger_event
nodes.summary: Public entry point to trigger a debounced status refresh for a repo, spawning the internal retry-aware handler.

nodes.name: trigger_event_internal
nodes.summary: Internal event handler that records the pending event and schedules a delayed flush, retrying if scheduling fails.

nodes.name: schedule_flush
nodes.summary: Schedules a delayed status flush on the Tauri async runtime (not plain `tokio::spawn`, since callers may run on a bare `std::thread`), canceling any previous pending flush for the repo.

nodes.name: cancel_debounce
nodes.summary: Cancels any pending debounced flush for a repository.

nodes.name: calculate_delay
nodes.summary: Computes the debounce delay: immediate for branch/git-meta/remote changes, adaptively 300-1000ms otherwise based on event volume and elapsed time.

nodes.name: flush_event
nodes.summary: Performs the actual git status refresh, emits the new status and any detected operation events, and serializes concurrent git subprocess execution via a single-slot semaphore to avoid FD exhaustion.

nodes.name: DebounceManager
nodes.summary: Coalesces rapid filesystem events per repository and triggers debounced git status refreshes, emitting synthesized operation events (commit/merge/rebase/conflict) to the frontend.

nodes.name: event_emitter.rs
nodes.summary: Wraps the Tauri `AppHandle` to emit repo/file/status/health/job change events to the frontend over WebSocket, including a legacy-compatible field layout for status updates.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs an `EventEmitter` wrapping the given Tauri `AppHandle`.

nodes.name: emit_repo_changed
nodes.summary: Emits a `repo:changed` event describing the change type and affected file count for a repository.

nodes.name: emit_file_changed
nodes.summary: Emits a single file-change event (path and event kind) for a repository.

nodes.name: emit_files_changed
nodes.summary: Broadcasts a batch file-change event over WebSocket for multiple changed files at once.

nodes.name: emit_status_updated
nodes.summary: Broadcasts an updated `GitStatus` snapshot over WebSocket, including legacy field names preserved for backward compatibility with older frontend consumers.

nodes.name: emit_git_operation
nodes.summary: Broadcasts a synthesized git operation event (e.g. commit, merge, rebase) with success flag and summary over WebSocket.

nodes.name: emit_job_event
nodes.summary: Emits a background job state-change event (priority, progress, error) for a repository.

nodes.name: emit_watcher_health
nodes.summary: Emits a watcher health-status change event with an optional reason.

nodes.name: emit_health_update
nodes.summary: Emits an aggregate health-update event covering all watched repositories.

nodes.name: emit_bulk_status_update
nodes.summary: Broadcasts cached status for multiple repositories at once, used after bulk operations.

nodes.name: EventEmitter
nodes.summary: Wraps the Tauri `AppHandle` to broadcast repo/file/status/health/job events to the frontend over WebSocket.

nodes.name: git_status.rs
nodes.summary: Runs and parses `git status --porcelain=v2 -b` in a single subprocess call (replacing 5-6 separate git invocations), detects unstaged renames via libgit2, and determines in-progress git operations (merge/rebase/cherry-pick/revert/bisect).

nodes.name: detect_unstaged_renames
nodes.summary: Uses libgit2's diff rename detection (including untracked files) to identify files that were renamed but not yet staged.

nodes.name: coalesce_git_status_renames
nodes.summary: Merges detected rename pairs into the porcelain-parsed staged file list, collapsing separate delete/add entries into a single rename entry.

nodes.name: coalesce_working_directory_renames
nodes.summary: Merges detected rename pairs into the working-directory (unstaged) file list.

nodes.name: refresh_git_status
nodes.summary: Async entry point that runs `git status --porcelain=v2 -b` with a 5-second timeout and parses the result into a `GitStatus`.

nodes.name: refresh_git_status_sync
nodes.summary: Synchronous wrapper around the git status refresh, used by the polling thread.

nodes.name: run_git_status_sync
nodes.summary: Core status parser: runs `git status --porcelain=v2 -b` and parses branch, ahead/behind, staged/unstaged/untracked/conflicted files from the `1 `/`2 `/`u `/`? ` porcelain sections, then layers in rename detection and in-progress-operation flags.

nodes.name: detect_git_operation_states
nodes.summary: Inspects `.git/MERGE_HEAD`, `rebase-merge`/`rebase-apply`, `CHERRY_PICK_HEAD`, `REVERT_HEAD`, and `BISECT_LOG` to determine which git operation (if any) is currently in progress, handling the `.git`-as-file worktree case.

nodes.name: get_detailed_file_status_sync
nodes.summary: Returns a detailed per-file status breakdown for the working directory, used by UI views that need more than the summary counts.

nodes.name: list_untracked_in_directory
nodes.summary: Lists untracked files within a specific directory, used to expand untracked-directory entries into individual files.

nodes.name: get_upstream_branch
nodes.summary: Resolves the upstream tracking branch name for the current local branch, if one is configured.
